prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original CYBERPUNK STREET FIGHTER sprite atlas for Sandbox Wars. A HUMAN urban arcade character, NOT fantasy, robot, medieval armor or creature. This is GAME ART, not UI. Rich consistent 16-bit pixel art, visible square pixel clusters, dark outlines, limited crisp shading ramps, no blurred soft painting, no photorealism.
OUTPUT square transparent PNG, exactly nine equal square cells arranged 3 columns by 3 rows. True alpha transparency. No background, floor shadows, checkerboard drawing, grid, labels or text. Leave minimum 7% clear padding inside EVERY cell, all body parts and effects wholly inside their own cell. All full-body poses face RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Common body scale throughout eight body frames, identical foot baseline 90% down cell, standing height max 80%. No detached effect particles outside character; gear must touch body. No lettering or brand marks.
First SIX cells in top two rows: six frames of a subtle CLEAN idle loop. Only tiny changes of breathing, knees and shoulders. Feet planted, head size and anatomy and costume absolutely consistent. No damage, tears or bandages in idle. Bottom-left cell: comically BATTERED exhausted full-body aftermath. Bottom-center: BATTERED tired victory full-body. Bottom-right: enlarged CLEAN head-and-shoulders portrait with pristine clothes, no bandages. Aftermath mildly scuffed or rumpled with one tiny adhesive bandage, no blood or realistic injury.
Make a distinct and original silhouette. No existing game character imitation. Exact character design and three pose specifications follow.
MODAL concept inspired by bright fresh green on black and translucent modular geometric forms. Lean tall adult East Asian woman, precise asymmetric platinum-white bob haircut with one clipped temple, pale mint rectangular cybernetic ear modules, calm assessing expression. Sleek graphite-black fitted jumpsuit, segmented translucent APPLE-GREEN angular shoulder plates, emerald belt modules, short geometric split vest (not a long coat or hoodie), fitted black trousers tapering into slim black high-tech ankle boots. Distinct large RECTANGULAR translucent green modular gauntlets with visible squared dark circuitry on both forearms. Palette apple green, pale mint, deep black, small silver details; NOT acid yellow-green rain jacket, no respirator, sunglasses, boxing gloves or fantasy robes. Real human skin and exposed face. Design has a sophisticated minimal geometric-tech aesthetic.
IDLE: relaxed upright precision-fighter posture, legs slightly offset, hands loosely steepled in front of chest with block gauntlets angled inward, subtle breath and tiny finger shift. No crouched boxer guard.
BATTERED: sitting sideways on one folded leg, one angular gauntlet propping up her head, platinum bob messy, shoulder panel cracked, small cheek bandage, flat exhausted stare.
VICTORY: standing tired, one hand gives a small dismissive outward wave at shoulder level while opposite gauntlet rests on hip, same cracked panel and cheek bandage, sardonic faint smile. No raised fist.
PORTRAIT: clean platinum geometric bob, mint ear tech, composed face and angular translucent green shoulder panel.

CLOUDFLARE concept: flamboyant orange FLAREPUNK industrial street fighter. Broad athletic adult human man with warm tan skin, bright ORANGE huge flame-shaped POMPADOUR hair with amber tips and shaved temples; the hair is stylized human hair shaped like a flame, not a magical burning skull. White tank top with soot-black harness straps, vivid orange industrial boiler-suit trousers with the upper suit unzipped and tied in a broad knot at waist, rugged black knee pads, thick black work boots with orange toe caps. Oversized mechanical dark-metal forearm heat gauntlets with attached bright orange vent slits shaped like tiny flames, all effects integrated into gauntlets, no floating fire. Palette strong safety orange, amber, charcoal, off-white. Confident grin, single silver eyebrow piercing. Human urban mechanic/raver vibe, no firefighter helmet, fantasy armor, weapons, magic elemental body or robot.
IDLE: broad grounded stance, elbows held out with heavy gauntlets hanging near hips, shoulders rolling slightly, cocky grin, flame pompadour bobbing subtly over six consistent frames. No boxing fists by face.
BATTERED: down on both knees, gauntlets resting heavily on thighs, pompadour hilariously drooped to one side, soot-smudged white tank and small temple bandage, eyes wide and dazed.
VICTORY: standing tired, one big gauntlet at hip and other hand running through drooping flame pompadour to prop it up, weary swaggering grin, same soot and bandage. Not raised-fist celebration.
PORTRAIT: pristine tank straps, broad human face, huge crisp flame-shaped orange pompadour and eyebrow piercing.

BOXD concept: disciplined DUTCH CYBERPUNK KICKBOXER in MAROON and BLACK. Tall lean muscular adult human man, light skin, close-cropped pale blond hair, strong nose, focused brows. Shirtless torso with fine black geometric circuit tattoos on shoulder and ribs, MAROON satin kickboxing shorts with wide black waistband and subtle pale-gray side piping, large BLACK boxing gloves with maroon wrist straps, futuristic charcoal lightweight SHIN GUARDS strapped over calves with maroon light strips, black ankle wraps and exposed human toes. Small black cybernetic temple implant. No shirt, jacket, cape, cargo pants or boots. Urban underground Dutch kickboxing gym aesthetic, not fantasy armor. Maroon should be rich wine red, not neon pink or orange. Athletic anatomical proportions, distinguish silhouette by gloves and bare lower legs.
IDLE: authentic compact Dutch kickboxing high guard, both gloved hands near cheeks, elbows tucked, torso upright slightly forward, staggered feet, front heel subtly lifted and set down across six frames with minimal bounce. Not a karate pose, no high kick in idle. Clean before fight.
BATTERED: seated on floor knees bent, one glove draped over a raised knee and other glove presses tired forehead, small nose bridge bandage, sweaty and exhausted but no blood.
VICTORY: standing slouched with chin lifted, both gloves lightly tapped together at sternum in quiet acknowledgment, small nose bandage, a weary half smile; not arms raised overhead.
PORTRAIT: close-cropped blond head, stern clean face, dark temple implant, one maroon-trimmed black glove held beside cheek, tattooed shoulder. No injuries or bandage.
